prediction_rule: Regenerate the inherited input selection before use. Freeze BOTH complete source-bound full-target predictions before ANY held-out native acquisition. Validated same-v3 checkpoint continuation requires explicit restored-prefix provenance. No refit, resampling or case replacement based on outputs.
artifact_integrity_rule: Whole-file SHA256 recorded separately; this revision is a binding declaration, not a passing end-to-end experiment.
